entities.name: Orvada
entities.description: Powerful merchant empire of the Domains on Dominaria that rivals Benalia, named for its main city.

entities.name: Walassa
entities.description: Southern island hosting the capital city Orvada and a Tolarian Academy campus.

entities.name: Lucassa
entities.description: Coastal city known for its grand lighthouse.

entities.name: Tolarian Academy
entities.description: Prestigious academy that opened a campus on Walassa.

entities.name: Galina
entities.description: Ruler of Etlan Shiis who reappeared around 3200 AR with an unnaturally extended life.

entities.name: Tarin
entities.description: Orvadan fisherman embroiled in a failed conspiracy to depose Galina.

entities.name: Joryev of Orvada
entities.description: Enigmatic lieutenant of Torsten Von Ursus who helped establish House Joryev in Benalia.

entities.name: Torsten Von Ursus
entities.description: Benalian leader whose lieutenant was Joryev.

entities.name: House Joryev
entities.description: One of the Seven Great Houses of Benalia.

entities.name: Lyra Dawnbringer
entities.description: Commander of the Serran hosts supplied by Orvada.

events.summary: Tarin becomes embroiled in a conspiracy to depose Galina, which fails.
events.quote: the Orvadan fisherman Tarin became embroiled in a conspiracy to depose her and end her reign

events.summary: Around 3500 AR Joryev of Orvada helps establish House Joryev as one of the Seven Great Houses of Benalia.
events.quote: helping to establish House Joryev as one of the Seven Great Houses of Benalia

events.summary: After the second Phyrexian Invasion, Orvada's merchant lords negotiate peace with Benalia and supply the Serran hosts of Lyra Dawnbringer.
events.quote: Orvada's powerful merchant lords negotiated a fragile peace with Benalia

relations.quote: Joryev of Orvada emerged as one of the most enigmatic lieutenants of Torsten Von Ursus
played a crucial role in supplying food, ships, and provisions to the Serran hosts commanded by Lyra Dawnbringer
